1507.title: Probe: every monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula for the edge function of the Petersen graph has depth at least 5
1507.plain_statement: For the Petersen graph on inputs 0..9 (outer cycle 0-1-2-3-4-0, spokes i to i + 5, inner pentagram 5-7-9-6-8-5), the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true has no monotone formula of depth at most 4. A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.

127.title: De Morgan leaf size of the edge function is (edges) + (cover number) on graphs acyclic after removing middle edges
127.formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (t s : ℕ), (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v) → (SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun b c : Fin n => G.Adj b c ∧ ¬ (∃ a d : Fin n, G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ a ≠ d ∧ ¬ G.Adj a d ∧ (∀ w, G.Adj b w → w = a ∨ w = c) ∧ (∀ w, G.Adj c w → w = b ∨ w = d) ∧ (∃ z, ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w = b ∨ w = z) ∧ (∃ z, ∀ w, G.Adj d w → w = c ∨ w = z)) ∧ ¬ (∃ a d : Fin n, G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj b d ∧ a ≠ d ∧ ¬ G.Adj a d ∧ (∀ w, G.Adj c w → w = a ∨ w = b) ∧ (∀ w, G.Adj b w → w = c ∨ w = d) ∧ (∃ z, ∀ w, G.Adj a w → w = c ∨ w = z) ∧ (∃ z, ∀ w, G.Adj d w → w = b ∨ w = z)))).IsAcyclic → (∃ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S ∧ S.card = t) → (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S → t ≤ S.card) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasLeafSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) s ↔ G.edgeFinset.card + t ≤ s)
127.plain_statement: De Morgan formulas: literal leaves (negation free at leaves), AND, OR; size = number of leaves. Graph with an edge that is acyclic once its middle edges are removed (bc is a middle edge if a - b - c - d is a path, a, d distinct and non-adjacent, b, c with no other neighbour, a, d with at most two). Contains forests, cycles of length at least 5, subdivisions with four or more inner vertices per edge. Then the edge function has a formula with s leaves iff edges + least cover size <= s. Paper proof, cold referee. Conjecture until checked.

2908.title: One-line soundness prices monotone formulas: true on every flag, false on each line with all points off it, costs at least flags plus a vertex cover in leaves
2908.formal_statement:
∀ (P L : ℕ) (I : Fin P → Fin L → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (φ : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula (P + L)),
  (∀ l l' : Fin L, l ≠ l' → ∀ p p' : Fin P, I p l → I p l' → I p' l → I p' l' → p = p') →
  (∀ l : Fin L, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin P => I p l)).card) →
  (∀ p : Fin P, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin L => I p l)).card) →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula.rec (motive := fun _ : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula (P + L) => Prop)
    (fun (_ : Fin (P + L)) (c : Bool) => c = true) (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) φ →
  (∀ (p : Fin P) (l : Fin L), I p l →
    φ.eval (fun k => decide (k = Fin.castAdd L p ∨ k = Fin.natAdd P l)) = true) →
  (∀ m : Fin L,
    φ.eval (fun k => decide ((∃ p : Fin P, k = Fin.castAdd L p ∧ ¬ I p m) ∨ k = Fin.natAdd P m)) = false) →
  ∃ (TP : Finset (Fin P)) (TL : Finset (Fin L)),
    (∀ (p : Fin P) (l : Fin L), I p l → p ∈ TP ∨ l ∈ TL) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin P × Fin L => I f.1 f.2)).card + TP.card + TL.card ≤ φ.leaves
2908.plain_statement: Points 0..P-1 and lines 0..L-1 with an incidence in which two lines share at most one point, every line has at least 2 points and every point is on at least 2 lines; inputs are the P point bits then the L line bits. Let phi be a formula of AND and OR gates over positive literals, true on every input with exactly one point and one line on, the point on the line, and, for every line m, false on the input with m and exactly the points off m on. Then some set of points and lines covering every incident pair has incident pairs plus its size at most the leaves of phi.

909.title: Petersen graph: some circuit with at most 6 AND gates, ORs free, is correct on its partial function with each variable bare in at most two gates
909.formal_statement:
∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin 10), G = SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun a b : Fin 10 => ((a : ℕ), (b : ℕ)) ∈ ([(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 0), (0, 5), (1, 6), (2, 7), (3, 8), (4, 9), (5, 7), (7, 9), (9, 6), (6, 8), (8, 5)] : List (ℕ × ℕ))) →
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.AndCount.AndCountCircuit 10, C.WellFormed ∧ C.size ≤ 6 ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 10, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin C.size => v ∈ C.leftVars i ∨ v ∈ C.rightVars i)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ I : Finset (Fin 10), (∀ a ∈ I, ∀ c ∈ I, ¬ G.Adj a c) → (∀ w : Fin 10, w ∉ I → ∃ a ∈ I, G.Adj a w) →
      C.eval I = false ∧ ∀ w : Fin 10, w ∉ I → C.eval (insert w I) = true)
909.plain_statement: Petersen graph on vertices 0..9 with edges 0-1 1-2 2-3 3-4 4-0 0-5 1-6 2-7 3-8 4-9 5-7 7-9 9-6 6-8 8-5. Circuits: AND gates of two sides, each side an OR of variables and earlier gates, output an OR, only ANDs counted. A circuit is correct on the partial function of G when it outputs 0 at every maximal independent set I of G (as the set of true variables) and 1 at I plus any one vertex outside I. Some circuit with at most 6 ANDs is correct and every variable is bare in at most two gates.
